events.text: I'm verifying the T-400 connector-status code and probing it locally. Next, I'll find out how to start the private local centre on port 8961.

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh | head -30; grep -nE "PORT|argv|port" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8; tail -40 workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-400.json 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "wrangler dev[^\"]{0,200}|vendor-sim.py[^\"]{0,80}" | head -5

events.name: Bash

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start private sim and local centre

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for centre to come up
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8961/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q "[0-9][0-9][0-9]" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8961/ | grep -qv 000 && break; sleep 2; done; tail -3 /tmp/t400-verify/centre.log; ls migrations 2>/dev/null | wc -l; grep -n "d1\|migrat" package.json | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply D1 migrations to private state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; DB=$(grep -oE '"database_name": *"[^"]+"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo $DB; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $DB --local --persist-to /tmp/t400-verify/state --config wrangler.jsonc 2>&1 | tail -3

events.text: The local centre and simulator are up. Next I'm running the delivery probe.

events.text: The local probe passes, including the WhatsApp connector check. Next I'm doing a read-only check of the live centre's delivery status.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read live delivery status (GET only)
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; K=$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key); curl -s -H "x-admin-key: $K" https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/delivery | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print({k:d.get(k) for k in ('on','key_saved','sender','whatsapp','tantra_whatsapp')}, [c['id'] for c in d.get('campaigns',[])])"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read live delivery status with admin session
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; U=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev; K=$(cat ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key); C=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST --data-urlencode "token=$K" $U/admin/enter | grep -i '^set-cookie' | sed -E 's/^[^:]+: *([^;]+).*/\1/' | head -1); curl -s -H "cookie: $C" -H "origin: $U" $U/admin/api/delivery | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print({k:d.get(k) for k in ('on','key_saved','sender','whatsapp','tantra_whatsapp')}, [c['id'] for c in d.get('campaigns',[])])"
